description: This Kotlin source file defines the PreferencesRepository class, which manages user preferences using Jetpack DataStore in an Android application. It provides properties for observing preferences via Kotlin Flows and functions to update preferences atomically, including SSH configuration, selected app packages, flags, and timestamps.

classes.name: PreferencesRepository
classes.description: Singleton class providing access to user preferences via DataStore, including SSH settings, selected packages, flags, and timestamps.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PreferencesRepository, initialized with the application context.

methods.name: setSshHost
methods.description: Sets the SSH host string after validation.

methods.name: setSshPort
methods.description: Sets the SSH port after validation.

methods.name: setSshUsername
methods.description: Sets the SSH username after validation.

methods.name: setSshCommandTemplate
methods.description: Sets the SSH command template string.

methods.name: setSshConfig
methods.description: Sets all SSH configuration parameters atomically.

methods.name: setSelectedPackages
methods.description: Replaces the set of selected package names.

methods.name: addSelectedPackage
methods.description: Adds a package to the selected set.

methods.name: removeSelectedPackage
methods.description: Removes a package from the selected set.

methods.name: setRunOnlyWhenUnlocked
methods.description: Sets whether execution is restricted to device unlocked state.

properties.name: sshConfigFlow
properties.description: Flow emitting current SSH configuration with default values.

properties.name: selectedPackagesFlow
properties.description: Flow emitting current set of selected app package names.

properties.name: runOnlyWhenUnlockedFlow
properties.description: Flow emitting whether to run only when device is unlocked.
